Not the black one... worse! The red one!
Look at the blades on it! Bar the doors!
It's laughing! Why is it laughing?
The red thing's in the street! Get the children in!
It doesn't eat, it just kills! RUN!
Red! Red and moving! Somebody get a torch!
That's the one from the bad craters! Shut the gates!
It's all hooks and teeth! Don't look at it, run!
It's not hungry, it's having fun! GO!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.symbiote_wh: A white one... like the quiet warrior in the old songs.
Is that... the quiet warrior's cloak? He's been dead for ages!
White as bone. Mother always said the quiet warrior wore white.
Don't run, don't run... the white one never hurt our kind. Did it?
It's the white knight from the old songs! It can't be!
Get back! It might be white, but it's still a living tar!
The quiet warrior's come back for us. Or for something.
Stories said he wore it like a cloak. That's no cloak.
Gods, it's pale all over. Is it a ghost?
White suit. Grandfather swore he saw one, once. Nobody believed him.

Red today. That's the angry one, isn't it?
I know it's you under there. I'm still going to stand over here.

Keep its hooks to yourself, please.

The black one was bad enough. Now it's red.
Hello again. Tell your friend not to look at me like that.

The children call you the butcher's apron. I didn't teach them that.

talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.symbiote_w: The white suit again. You look like the quiet warrior in the songs.
White as the quiet warrior's cloak. Do you know the old story?
My grandmother would have knelt. I'll just say good morning.

You walk quieter in that one. Like him.
Hello, hero. Don't let it go to your head.
They say the quiet warrior fought with a little knife and that white cloak.
The children play at the old wars when you've been by. You're always the quiet warrior.
I sleep better knowing the white one's about.
The white one, not the black. Good. Much better.
The old songs never said he was this pale. Or this... wet.
If you're the quiet warrior come again, we've got monsters. Plenty.
